answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Like a deep river of liquidity, stake creates a high cost of entry. An attacker must expend a walnut sized fraction of total supply to signal malicious intent, risking catastrophic financial forfeiture. By tethering identity to verifiable economic skin in the game, the network forces adversaries to bear the full cost of their own potential disruption.
